analogs.description: Following the 2008 financial crisis, WTI crude oil entered a strong bullish trend with SMA alignment and price above key moving averages. The RSI was in a neutral to slightly bullish range, similar to the current setup.
analogs.outcome: WTI Crude Oil saw a sustained bullish move, gaining approximately 15-20% over the subsequent 20 trading days.

analogs.description: In the lead-up to the 2011 gold peak, commodities, including oil, experienced a strong bullish trend characterized by favorable SMA alignment and prices above key averages. The RSI was in a similar neutral zone.
analogs.outcome: WTI Crude Oil continued its upward trajectory, appreciating by around 10-15% in the 10-15 trading days following this technical setup.

analogs.description: After the initial COVID crash, WTI crude oil began a significant recovery. The technicals showed a strong bullish trend with SMA alignment and prices breaking above key averages, mirroring the current situation. RSI was also in a neutral to bullish range.
analogs.outcome: The recovery phase saw WTI Crude Oil surge by over 25% in the 20 trading days following this technical configuration.

A.key_lesson: Strong bullish SMA alignment in a recovery or trending market often precedes further upside momentum, even with neutral RSI.
